acceptance: F009a: MemoryStore indexes JSONL traces, excludes test/ScriptedLLM/unverified episodes (26 tests pass)

Corpus check: hardened parser gives identical recovery_actions and failure_codes on all 77 frozen-corpus episodes
F009b Stage 2 hardening: INDEX_VERSION=2 forces reparse of older indexes; duplicate call IDs never labelled recoveries; non-dict args tolerated; end-to-end AgentLoop->trace->parser test

Success eligibility requires episode_end success/goal_met AND a passing FINAL goal_check (early failed finish then verified completion is eligible; an earlier passing check cannot rescue a failed final one); corpus unchanged (77/77)
Full suite: 104 passed, 5 skipped (robosuite x4, RUN_OLLAMA x1); 3 live Qwen3 tests in test_loop.py run against a local Ollama when it is up (requires_server mark is not registered)
features.notes: F009a complete. F009b Stage 1 complete (safe memory injection). F009b Stage 2: recovery-action extraction corrected; memory-on/off behavioral comparisons are CONFOUNDED: traces/ollama_repro_audit_v1 shows byte-identical first-turn requests to qwen3:8b on Ollama 0.40.2 yield different first actions depending on preceding-request history (observe cold vs pick after another prompt; mechanism unverified). All pilot/ablation results under traces/ are marked confounded (traces/CONFOUNDED_COMPARISONS.md). 30-pair evaluation NOT run and blocked until each LLM call can be made from a controlled, recorded server history. Known limitations: only the first success after a failure is recorded (observe can occupy the slot); AgentLoop re-saves the index on every memory-on run; 'N days ago' makes memory prompts time-dependent. Proposed next feature: observation-grounding contract (reject physical skills not grounded in a fresh tool observation). BACKLOG: parser/loop inconsistency - an env SkillOutcome(ok=False, failure=None) is a success to the loop (verify returns None) but a failure to the memory parser, which can create a spurious pending failure and recovery label; not fixed (no runtime change). BACKLOG: regenerate traces/.memory_index_frozen.json at INDEX_VERSION 2 before any further evaluation.

features.title: Observation-grounding contract for pose-dependent actions
acceptance: pick/place (any skill with coordinate args) execute only if grounded in a world_state the loop returned to the LLM in a tool result of the current episode; otherwise FailureCode.UNGROUNDED_ACTION before any env execution
Grounding snapshot captured once per llm.step turn; results produced during a turn ground only later turns (observe+pick and pick+place in one turn are rejected)
Grounding records rebuilt from the delivered world_state, reset per episode; task text, memory text and model output never ground (memory with coordinates in its text still rejected)
pick: target object present in the delivered state and not moved beyond GRASP_TOL since; unrelated objects moving do not invalidate
place: delivered gripper holding state equals live holding state (destination/support pose not grounded)
Check runs after validate_call (existing codes keep precedence) and once per tool call (GRASP_SLIP retries unchanged)

Rejections return fresh world_state, count toward max_failures, and are logged as grounding_check + validation_error; grounding_check records source_seq, source_call_id, source_step, live_step; llm_turn records grounding_source_seq/grounding_step

Tests: 27 new loop tests + 2 unit tests (blind-correct pick, multi-call turns, reset isolation, failure/SKIPPED state grounding, holding transitions, target moved while planning, message mutation during step, failure budget, memory parse of UNGROUNDED trace); 7 older tests gained an initial observe or a restructured turn, assertions unchanged
Mutation check: with grounding disabled, all 9 original rejection tests fail
Non-server suite 128 passed, 5 skipped, 3 deselected; full suite with local Ollama 131 passed, 5 skipped
features.notes: Interfaces unchanged (LLMClient, RobotEnv, SYSTEM_PROMPT, memory retrieval, model settings). Limitations: place destination/support pose is not grounded; pick does not compare holding state, so a contrived same-turn place-then-pick at the carry position passes; requires_grounding keys on an 'x' arg, so future coordinate skills need explicit freshness rules; Grounding.state is a mutable pydantic model that no code mutates; no max state age (needed for real hardware); robosuite tests not run (ROBOT_AGENT_ROBOSUITE_PYTHON unset); once a state is delivered, a guess within GRASP_TOL is indistinguishable from reading it. UNGROUNDED_ACTION enters F009 memory failure codes (see B004).
